s.d: λατρεύω (λάτρις, a hired servant), [in LXX (always, as λατρεία, of the service of God or of heathen divinities) chiefly for עָבַד, [[exodus 3 12|Exo.3:12]], al.; in Dan LXX TH ([[daniel 3 12|Dan.3:12]], al.) for פְּלַח ;] 1. to work for hire. 2. to serve; in cl., also of divine service, to serve, worship, and so always in NT: with dative of person(s), τ. θεῷ, [[matthew 4 10|Mat.4:10]], [[luke 4 8|Luk.4:8]]" (LXX), [[acts 7 7|Act.7:7 24:14 27:23]], [[hebrews 9 14|Heb.9:14]], [[revelation 7 15|Rev.7:15 22:3]]; of idol worship (cf. [[exodus 20 5|Exo.20:5]], [[ezekiel 20 32|Eze.20:32]]), [[acts 7 42|Act.7:42]], [[romans 1 25|Rom.1:25]]; τ. θεῷ. ἐν τ. πνεύματί μου, [[romans 1 9|Rom.1:9;]] id. ἐν καθαρᾷ συνειδήσει, [[2-timothy 1 3|2Ti.1:3;]] μετ᾽ εὐλαβείας κ. δέους, [[hebrews 12 28|Heb.12:28;]] ἐν ὁσιότητι κ. δικαιοσύνῃ, [[luke 1 74|Luk.1:74;]] (without θεῷ) νηστείαις κ. δεήσεσι, [[luke 2 37|Luk.2:37;]] πνεύματι θεοῦ, [[philippians 3 3|Php.3:3;]] absol., [[acts 26 7|Act.26:7;]] ὁ λατρεύων, the worshipper, [[hebrews 9 9|Heb.9:9 10:2]]; of ministerial service, with dative of thing(s), [[hebrews 8 5|Heb.8:5 13:10]].† SYN.: λειτουργέω, q.v (AS)

λάχανον, -ου, τό (λαχαίνω, to dig), [in LXX: [[genesis 9 3|Gen.9:3;]] [[1-kings 21 2|3Ki.21:2]], [[psalms 37 2|Psa.37:2]], [[proverbs 15 17|Pro.15:17]] (יֶרֶק, יָרָק) * ;] a garden herb, vegetable: [[luke 11 42|Luk.11:42;]] usually in pl., [[matthew 13 32|Mat.13:32]], [[mark 4 32|Mrk.4:32]], [[romans 14 2|Rom.14:2]].† SYN.: βοτάνη, q.v (AS)

λεββαῖος, -ου, ὁ (on the derivation, see Dalman, Words, 50; Swete, Mk., l.with), Lebbæus: [[matthew 10 3|Mat.10:3]], [[mark 3 18|Mrk.3:18]] (WH, mg.; Θαδδαῖος, which see, Rec., WH, txt., RV, cf. WH, App., 11, 24. In [[luke 6 15|Luk.6:15]], [[acts 1 13|Act.1:13]], he is called Σίμων ὁ Ζηλωτής.)† (AS)
λεγιών (Rec. -εών), -ῶνος, ἡ, (Lat. legio), a legion: [[matthew 26 53|Mat.26:53]], [[mark 5 9|Mrk.5:9, 15]], [[luke 8 30|Luk.8:30]].† (AS)

λέγω, [in LXX very freq., chiefly for אמר; λέγει for נְאֻם, [[genesis 22 16|Gen.22:16]], al. ;] 1. in Hom., to pick out, gather, reckon, recount. 2. In Hdt. and Att., to say, speak, affirm, declare: absol., [[acts 13 15|Act.13:15, 24:10]]; before orat. dir., [[matthew 9 34|Mat.9:34]], [[mark 3 11|Mrk.3:11]], [[john 1 29|Jhn.1:29]], al.; before ὅτι recit., [[mark 3 21|Mrk.3:21]], [[luke 1 24|Luk.1:24]], [[john 6 14|Jhn.6:14]], al.; accusative and inf., [[luke 11 18|Luk.11:18]], [[john 12 29|Jhn.12:29]], al.; after another verb of speaking, προσφωνεῖν κ. λέγειν, [[matthew 11 17|Mat.11:17]], al.; ἀπεκρίθη (ἐλάλησεν) λέγων (καὶ λέγει; Dalman, Words, 24 ff.), [[matthew 25 9|Mat.25:9]], [[mark 3 33|Mrk.3:33, 7:28]], [[luke 24 6|Luk.24:6]], 7, al.; of unspoken thought, λ. ἐν ἑαυτῷ, [[matthew 3 9|Mat.3:9]], [[luke 3 8|Luk.3:8]], al.; of writing, [[2-corinthians 8 8|2Co.8:8]], [[philippians 4 11|Php.4:11]], al.; λέγει ἡ γραφή, [[romans 4 3|Rom.4:3]], [[james 2 23|Jas.2:23]], al.; with accusative of thing(s), [[luke 8 8|Luk.8:8, 9:33]], [[john 5 34|Jhn.5:34]], al.; σὺ λέγεις (a non-committal phrase; Swete, Mk., 359, 369f.), [[matthew 27 11|Mat.27:11]], [[mark 15 2|Mrk.15:2]], [[luke 23 3|Luk.23:3]], [[john 18 37|Jhn.18:37]]; with dative of person(s), before orat. dir., [[matthew 8 20|Mat.8:20]], [[mark 2 17|Mrk.2:17]], al. mult.; id. before ὅτι, [[matthew 3 9|Mat.3:9]], al.; with prep., πρός, μετά, περί, etc., [[mark 4 41|Mrk.4:41]], [[john 11 56|Jhn.11:56]], [[hebrews 9 5|Heb.9:5]], al.; to mean (cl.), [[mark 14 71|Mrk.14:71]], [[john 6 71|Jhn.6:71]], [[1-corinthians 10 29|1Co.10:29]], al.; to call, name, [[mark 10 18|Mrk.10:18;]] pass., [[matthew 9 9|Mat.9:9]], [[mark 15 7|Mrk.15:7]], al (cf. ἀντι-, δια- (-μαι), προ-, συλ-λέγω). SYN.: λαλέω, which refers to the utterance, as λέγω to the meaning of what is said, its correspondence with thought (Tr., Syn., Ixxvi; Thayer, see word λαλέω). (AS)

In Hdt. and Att., to say, speak, affirm, declare: absol., [[acts 13 15|Act.13:15, 24:10]]; before orat. dir., [[matthew 9 34|Mat.9:34]], [[mark 3 11|Mrk.3:11]], [[john 1 29|Jhn.1:29]], al.; before ὅτι recit., [[mark 3 21|Mrk.3:21]], [[luke 1 24|Luk.1:24]], [[john 6 14|Jhn.6:14]], al.; accusative and inf., [[luke 11 18|Luk.11:18]], [[john 12 29|Jhn.12:29]], al.; after another verb of speaking, προσφωνεῖν κ. λέγειν, [[matthew 11 17|Mat.11:17]], al.; ἀπεκρίθη (ἐλάλησεν) λέγων (καὶ λέγει; Dalman, Words, 24 ff.), [[matthew 25 9|Mat.25:9]], [[mark 3 33|Mrk.3:33, 7:28]], [[luke 24 6|Luk.24:6]], 7, al.; of unspoken thought, λ. ἐν ἑαυτῷ, [[matthew 3 9|Mat.3:9]], [[luke 3 8|Luk.3:8]], al.; of writing, [[2-corinthians 8 8|2Co.8:8]], [[philippians 4 11|Php.4:11]], al.; λέγει ἡ γραφή, [[romans 4 3|Rom.4:3]], [[james 2 23|Jas.2:23]], al.; with accusative of thing(s), [[luke 8 8|Luk.8:8, 9:33]], [[john 5 34|Jhn.5:34]], al.; σὺ λέγεις (a non-committal phrase; Swete, Mk., 359, 369f.), [[matthew 27 11|Mat.27:11]], [[mark 15 2|Mrk.15:2]], [[luke 23 3|Luk.23:3]], [[john 18 37|Jhn.18:37]]; with dative of person(s), before orat. dir., [[matthew 8 20|Mat.8:20]], [[mark 2 17|Mrk.2:17]], al. mult.; id. before ὅτι, [[matthew 3 9|Mat.3:9]], al.; with prep., πρός, μετά, περί, etc., [[mark 4 41|Mrk.4:41]], [[john 11 56|Jhn.11:56]], [[hebrews 9 5|Heb.9:5]], al.; to mean (cl.), [[mark 14 71|Mrk.14:71]], [[john 6 71|Jhn.6:71]], [[1-corinthians 10 29|1Co.10:29]], al.; to call, name, [[mark 10 18|Mrk.10:18;]] pass., [[matthew 9 9|Mat.9:9]], [[mark 15 7|Mrk.15:7]], al (cf. ἀντι-, δια- (-μαι), προ-, συλ-λέγω). SYN.: λαλέω, which refers to the utterance, as λέγω to the meaning of what is said, its correspondence with thought (Tr., Syn., Ixxvi; Thayer, see word λαλέω). (AS)
λεῖμμα (WH, λίμμα, see their App., 154), -τος, τό (λείπω), [in LXX: [[2-kings 19 4|4Ki.19:4]] A (שְׁאֵרִית)* ;] a remnant: [[romans 11 5|Rom.11:5.]]† (AS)

λεῖος, -εία, -εῖον [in LXX: [[genesis 27 11|Gen.27:11]], [[1-samuel 17 40|1Ki.17:40]] R (חָלַק, חַלֻּק); ὁδὸς λ., [[isaiah 40 4|Isa.40:4]] Α (בִּקְעָה); [[proverbs 2 20|Pro.2:20 12:13 26:23]] * ;] smooth: opposite to τραχύς, [[luke 3 5|Luk.3:5]] (LXX).† (AS)

λείπω [in LXX: [[job 4 11|Job.4:11]], [[proverbs 19 4|Pro.19:4]] (פָּרַד), al. ;] 1. trans., to leave, leave behind; pass., to be left behind, to lack before prep. (as more usual in cl.), ἐν, [[james 1 4|Jas.1:4;]] with genitive of thing(s), [[james 1 5|Jas.1:5 2:15]]. 2. Intrans., to be gone, to be wanting: with dative of person(s), [[luke 18 22|Luk.18:22]], [[titus 3 13|Tit.3:13]]; τὰ λείποντα, [[titus 1 5|Tit.1:5]] (cf. ἀπο-, δια-, ἐκ-, ἐπι-, κατα-, ἐν-κατα-, περι-, ὑπο-λείπω).† (AS)

λειτουργέω, -ῶ (λειτουργός), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁרַת pi., also for עָבַד, צָבָא, etc. ;] 1. in cl., at Athens, to supply public offices at one's own cost, render public service to the State, hence, generally, 2. to serve the State, do a service, serve (of service to the Gods, Diod., i, 21): of the official service of priests and Levites ([[exodus 29 30|Exo.29:30]], [[numbers 16 9|Num.16:9]], Sir.4:14, 1Ma.10:42, al.; cf. Deiss., BS, 140 f.), [[hebrews 10 11|Heb.10:11;]] of Christians: with dative of person(s) before ἐν, [[romans 15 27|Rom.15:27]] (cf. Sir.10:25); τ. κυρίῳ, [[acts 13 2|Act.13:2.]]† SYN.: λατρεύω (which see), prop., to serve for hire, LXX (as some­times in cl.), always of service to the deity on the part of both priests and people ([[exodus 4 3|Exo.4:3]], [[deuteronomy 10 12|Deu.10:12]], and similarly in NT). λειτουργέω "is the fulfilment of an office: it has a definite representative character, and corresponds with a function to be discharged". It is therefore used of serving in an office or ministry: in LXX always of priests and Levites, in NT, with its cognates ([[romans 13 6|Rom.13:6 15:27]], are not really exceptions), of services rendered either to God or man by apostles, prophets, teachers, and other officers of the church (cf. Tr., Syn., § xxxv; ICC on [[romans 1 9|Rom.1:9;]] Westc., He., 232 ff.) (AS)

λειτουργία, -ας, ἡ (λειτουργέω), [in LXX chiefly for עֲבֹדָה, [[numbers 4 24|Num.4:24]], [[1-chronicles 9 13|1Ch.9:13]], al. ;] 1. in cl. (chiefly of Athens), the discharge of a public office at one's own expense (see LS, see word), hence, 2. a service, ministry; in π. (Deiss., BS, 140 f.) and in LXX (though here also of secular service, [[1-kings 1 4|3Ki.1:4]], al.), of religious service or ministration; and so in NT: of priestly ministrations, [[luke 1 23|Luk.1:23]], [[hebrews 8 6|Heb.8:6 9:21]]; figuratively, θυσία καὶ λ. τῆς πίστεως ὑμῶν, [[philippians 2 17|Php.2:17;]] of Christian beneficence, [[2-corinthians 9 12|2Co.9:12]], [[philippians 2 30|Php.2:30]].† (AS)

λειτουργικός, -ή, -όν [in LXX for עֲבֹדָה, שָׁרַת; ἔργα, Num_7:5; στολαί [[exodus 31 10|Exo.31:10 39:32]]; σκευή, [[numbers 4 12|Num.4:12, 26]], [[2-chronicles 24 14|2Ch.24:14]] * ;] of or for service, ministering: πνεύματα, [[hebrews 1 14|Heb.1:14.]]† (AS)

λειτουργός, -οῦ, ὁ (λιός, ἔργον), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁרַת, [[joshua 1 1|Jos.1:1]] A, 3Ki.10:5, [[psalms 103 21|Psa.103:21]], Sir.7:30, al. ;] 1. in cl., one who discharges a public office at his own expense, then, generally, 2. a public servant, a minister, servant: τ. ἁγίων λ., [[hebrews 8 2|Heb.8:2]] (cf. [[nehemiah 10 39|Neh.10:39]], Sir, l.with); Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, [[romans 15 16|Rom.15:16;]] pl., τ. θεοῦ, [[romans 13 6|Rom.13:6]], [[hebrews 1 7|Heb.1:7]]" (LXX) ; λ. ὑμῶν τ. χρείας μου, [[philippians 2 25|Php.2:25.]]† SYN.: see: διάκονος, λειτουργέω (AS)
λέντιον, -ου, τό (Lat. linteum), a linen cloth, towel: [[john 13 4|Jhn.13:4-5.]]† (AS)
λεπίς, -ίδος, ἡ (λέπω, to peel) [in LXX chiefly for קַשְׂקֶשֶׂת ;] a scale: [[acts 9 18|Act.9:18]]† (AS)
λέπρα, -ας, ἡ (λεπρός), [in LXX for צָרַעַת ;] leprosy: [[matthew 8 3|Mat.8:3]], [[mark 1 42|Mrk.1:42]], [[luke 5 12|Luk.5:12-13]]† (AS)

λεπρός, -ά, -όν (λεπίς), [in LXX for צָרַע ;] 1. (in cl.) scaly, rough. 2. leprous; chiefly as subst., ὁ λ., a leper: [[matthew 8 2|Mat.8:2 10:8 11:5]], [[mark 1 40|Mrk.1:40]], [[luke 4 27|Luk.4:27 7:22 17:12]]; of Simon, formerly a leper, [[matthew 26 6|Mat.26:6]], [[mark 14 3|Mrk.14:3]].† (AS)

λεπτός, -ή, -όν (λέπω, to peel), 1. peeled. 2. fine, thin, small, light; hence, in late Gk., as subst. τὸ λ., a small coin (one-eighth of an as, AV, mite): [[mark 12 42|Mrk.12:42]], [[luke 12 59|Luk.12:59 21:2]].† (AS)

Λευείτης (Rec. Λευΐτης), -ου, ὁ [in LXX for לֵוִיִּי ;] a Levite: [[luke 10 32|Luk.10:32]], [[john 1 19|Jhn.1:19]], [[acts 4 36|Act.4:36]].† (AS)

λευκο-βύσσινος, -ον (cf. λευκολινής, a robe of white flax, C.I., 155, 17), white linen: [[revelation 19 14|Rev.19:14]] (WH, mg.).† λευκός, ή, -όν [in LXX chiefly for לָבָן ;] 1. bright, brilliant: of clothing, [[matthew 17 2|Mat.17:2]], [[mark 9 3|Mrk.9:3 16:5]], [[luke 9 29|Luk.9:29]], [[acts 1 10|Act.1:10]], [[revelation 3 5|Rev.3:5 4:4 6:11 7:9, 13 19:14]] (cf. λέων, -οντος, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for אֲרִי, אַרְיֵה, also for כְּפִיר, etc. ;] a lion: [[hebrews 11 33|Heb.11:33]], [[1-peter 5 8|1Pe.5:8]], [[revelation 4 7|Rev.4:7 9:8, 17 10:3 13:2]]; metaphorically, [[2-timothy 4 17|2Ti.4:17]], [[revelation 5 5|Rev.5:5]].† (AS)
λήθη, -ης, ἡ (λήθω = λανθάνω) [in LXX: [[leviticus 5 15|Lev.5:15]] (מַעַל), Wis.16:11, Sir.14:7, al. ;] forgetfulness: λ. λαβεῖν (on the phrase, see Mayor, in l): [[2-peter 1 9|2Pe.1:9.]]† (AS)

ληνός, -οῦ, ἡ (in some MSS., LXX and NT, ὁ), [in LXX chiefly for יֶקֶב [[numbers 18 27|Num.18:27]], al.; also for רַהַט ([[genesis 30 38|Gen.30:38, 41]]), גַּת ([[nehemiah 13 15|Neh.13:15]], al.), etc. ;] a trough or vat; esp. for the treading of grapes: [[matthew 21 33|Mat.21:33]], [[revelation 14 20|Rev.14:20 19:16]]; τὴν λ. . . . τὸν μέγαν (a solecism perhaps inadvertent), [[revelation 14 19|Rev.14:19]] (cf. ὑπολήνιον).† (AS)
λῆρος, -ου, ὁ [in LXX: 4Ma.5:10 * ;] silly talk, nonsense: [[luke 24 11|Luk.24:11.]]† (AS)

λῃστής, -οῦ, ὁ (Ep. ληίς = λεία, booty), [in LXX for גְּדוּד, etc. ;] a robber, brigand: [[matthew 21 13|Mat.21:13]] (LXX) [[matthew 26 55|Mat.26:55 27:38, 44]], [[mark 11 17|Mrk.11:17 14:48 15:27]], [[luke 10 30|Luk.10:30, 36 19:46 22:52]], [[john 10 1|Jhn.10:1, 8 18:40]], [[2-corinthians 11 26|2Co.11:26]].† SYN.: κλέπτης, q.v (AS)

λῆμψις (Rec. λῆψις, so in cl.), -εως, ἡ (λαμβάνω), [in LXX (λῆψ-): [[proverbs 15 29|Pro.15:29;]] λ. δώρων, [[proverbs 15 27|Pro.15:27]] (מַתָּנָה); λ. καὶ δόσις, Sir.41:19 42:7 * ;] receiving: δόσις καὶ λ., [[philippians 4 15|Php.4:15.]]† (AS)

λίαν, adv. [in LXX chiefly for מְאֹד [[genesis 1 31|Gen.1:31 4:5]], [[jeremiah 24 3|Jer.24:3]], al.; Tob.9:4, 2Ma.11:1, al. ;] very, exceedingly: [[matthew 2 16|Mat.2:16 4:8 8:28 27:14]] [[mark 1 35|Mrk.1:35 6:51]] (Rec. λ. ἐκ περισσοῦ) [[mark 9 3|Mrk.9:3 16:2]], [[luke 23 8|Luk.23:8]], [[2-timothy 4 15|2Ti.4:15]], II Jn 4, 3Jn.3 (cf. ὑτερλίαν).† (AS)

λίβανος, -ου, ὁ (rarely ἡ), (from the Semitic; cf. the Heb. equiv.), [in LXX for לְבוֹנָה [[exodus 30 34|Exo.30:34]], [[isaiah 60 6|Isa.60:6;]] Sir.24:15, al. ;] 1. in cl., the frankincense-tree. 2. (Occas. in cl.) frankincense (so [[leviticus 2 1|Lev.2:1;]] cf. λιβανωτός): [[matthew 2 11|Mat.2:11]], [[revelation 18 13|Rev.18:13]].† (AS)

λιβανωτός, -οῦ, ὁ (λίβανος), [in LXX: [[1-chronicles 9 29|1Ch.9:29]], 3Ma.5:2 * ;] 1. in cl. (and LXX), frankincense, the gum of the libanus. 2. = Late Gk., λιβανωτρίς, a censer: [[revelation 8 3|Rev.8:3]], 5 (the same form appears in Inscr.; MM, xvi).† (AS)
Λιβερῖτνος, -ου, ὁ (Lat. libertinus), a freedman: ἡ συναγωγὴ ἡ λεγομένη Λιβερτίνων [[acts 6 9|Act.6:9]] (Bl. thinks the original reading was Λιβυστίνων, Phil. Gosp., 69 f.).† (AS)
Libya, the north part of Africa west of Egypt, (Odyssey by Homer); in later writers also for the whole Continent (ML)
